tags.name: SS Stavronikita
tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-07-16 (deep QA pass): length (365ft/111m), fire date (26 Aug 1976), casualties (6 dead), purchase (Oct 1977, $30,000), and sinking date (21 Nov 1978) confirmed across 4+ independent sources. Found a genuine conflict on who conducted the demolition: some sources credit a US Navy demolition team, insandoutsbarbados.com credits the US Army Corps of Engineers, and caribdiveguide.com says explosives experts came from Puerto Rico. Flagged as an explicit conflict in the markdown rather than picking one account. Declined to add an unconfirmed 'originally named Ohio' claim and an unconfirmed '4,000 ton' tonnage figure (single-source only).

tags.name: Eillon
tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-07-16 (deep QA pass): 110ft length, 17m depth, and 1996 sinking after Coast Guard seizure of a contraband-carrying vessel reconfirmed by 2 new independent sources (caribbean-beat.com/numa.net, insandoutsbarbados.com), in addition to the existing barbadossnorkelingtours.org. The specific date '8 June 1996' is only given by barbadossnorkelingtours.org; other sources only confirm the year, so markdown now attributes the exact day to that one source rather than stating it as universally confirmed. Declined to specify the drug type (marijuana) named by only one source - kept as generic 'contraband' per anti-hallucination policy on drug-specific details.
